steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as a price-based reverse auction awarded as a lot.
Apply the first offered reverse-auction pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Render and complete the auction pricing sheet for the line item.

args.goal: on the buyer's single-stage create screen, set the first line item's delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set only "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop with the saved terms visible on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the plant location and the required versus optional clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Invite one QA test vendor for the vendor-side submission.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the separate supplier portal session for the invited QA vendor.
Open the event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the required clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional clause is shown to the vendor.
Quote 100 for every line and submit the vendor bid.
Verify the vendor portal marks the bid as submitted, proving the optional clause did not block submission.
